title: $p$-primary and prime-to-$p$ torsion sheaves
statement:
Let $(C,F)$ be a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and let
$\operatorname{char}k=p>0$. The sheaf $F$ is *$p$-primary* if every element of
every geometric stalk $F_{\bar c}$ is killed by a power of $p$, and *prime to
$p$* if every such element has finite order coprime to $p$. In characteristic
zero, "prime to the characteristic" imposes no condition.

lean.note: attached by the lead at the attachment check of 2026-10-10: the two clauses of the definition are the two Lean predicates (p-primary: IsPrimaryTorsionSheaf, any scheme and any p; prime to p: IsTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder with S = Spec k, n a unit of k iff p does not divide n). The Lean quantifies over separably closed points where def-weil-geometric-point takes algebraically closed ones: the same stalks, since an etale stalk depends only on the separable closure of the point's field (a convention, not a split)
